context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 verified 3 new Organization module features: 1) Google Maps location_link field in event creation/edit form, displayed on event cards and headers. 2) WhatsApp wa.me link integration - each invitation row has WhatsApp button that opens modal with owner phone, company phone, custom phone input, and message preview including event details + Google Maps link. 3) Sector conflict prevention - auto-suggest filters companies by sector (1 per sector/sub_sector), manual add shows warning dialog when adding company from same sector but allows override with 'Bəli, əlavə et' button. Test data companies: ABC İnşaat MMC (İnşaat), Şirkət 1/2/3 LLC (İKT), Gültəkin logistika (İnşaat), Silo Construction (Kənd təsərrüfatı). WhatsApp uses wa.me links (opens browser), not WhatsApp Business API.

google_maps_location_link.details: Event form has 'Google Maps linki' input field (data-testid='event-location-link'). Location link stored in event and displayed on event cards ('Xəritə' link) and event header ('Google Maps' link).

whatsapp_integration.details: WhatsApp button on each invitation row (data-testid='whatsapp-{id}'). Modal shows: owner phone (Sahibkar nömrəsi), company phone (Şirkət nömrəsi), custom phone input (Başqa nömrəyə göndər), message preview with event date/time/venue/type and Google Maps link. Uses wa.me links.

sector_conflict_prevention.details: Auto-suggest filters by sector (1 company per sector/sub_sector), toast shows 'sektor toqquşması nəzərə alındı'. Manual add triggers /api/events/{id}/check-sector-conflict endpoint, shows warning dialog with conflicting company name and sector, allows override with 'Bəli, əlavə et' button.

event_crud.details: Create, read, update, delete events all working. location_link field properly stored and retrieved.

invitation_management.details: Invitations can be created via auto-suggest or manual add. Call status buttons work correctly. Obligation deduction logic: deducted only when call_status='Cavab verdi', not for 'Cavab vermədi'.
